resources.string: Ivala inkulumo, ukunyakaza kanye nokuthi “Hlola ngokuthinta” uze uqhubeke ne-SandFly
Ngesikhathi i-SandFly imisiwe okwesikhashana, ayikhulumi futhi ayiphenduli ekuthintweni, futhi isikrini sisebenza sengathi asikho isifundi sesikrini esivuliwe.
Ukuze uqhubeke, thepha isaziso esithi “SandFly imisiwe”, cindezela inkinobho yokwehlisa ivolumu izikhathi ezi-3 ngokushesha noma khiya bese uvusa ifoni ukuze kuvele isikrini sokukhiya.
